source_text: This is it? There’s nothing here.

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp.This is it? There’s nothing here.

translation: To tyle? Nic tu nie ma.

source_text: If I were to guess, there’s probably a secret entrance.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.If I were to guess, there’s probably a secret entrance.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.If I were to guess, there’s probably a secret entrance."

translation: Gdybym miał zgadywać, pewnie jest tu sekretne wejście.

source_text: Spread out. Look for anything out of place.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.Spread out. Look for anything out of place.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.Spread out. Look for anything out of place."

translation: Rozejdźcie się. Szukajcie czegoś nie na miejscu.

source_text: I don’t see anything.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I don’t see anything.

source_text: Look harder.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.Look harder.

source_text: Shit. This could take a while.

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp.Shit. This could take a while.

source_text: Maybe one of these shipping containers is on top of a secret passage.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Maybe one of these shipping containers is on top of a secret passage.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Maybe one of these shipping containers is on top of a secret passage."

translation: Może jeden z tych kontenerów stoi na tajnym przejściu.

source_text: Well?... Look and see.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.Well?... Look and see.

source_text: Get away from me, asshole.

structure.raw_value: MeAnOp.Get away from me, asshole.

source_text: What the hell!? You said you wanted it!

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.What the hell!? You said you wanted it!
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.What the hell!? You said you wanted it!"

translation: Co jest, do cholery!? Mówiłaś, że chcesz!

source_text: Get dressed. We need to get the hell out of here before the attendant gets back.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.Get dressed. We need to get the hell out of here before the attendant gets back.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.Get dressed. We need to get the hell out of here before the attendant gets back."

translation: Ubieraj się. Musimy spieprzać stąd, zanim wróci dozorca.

source_text: Back to being a bitch.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Back to being a bitch.

source_text: Shit! Jon’s back!

structure.raw_value: McWoClNo1.Shit! Jon’s back!

source_text: Fuck!... Hide!

structure.raw_value: MeShClNo1.Fuck!... Hide!

source_text: Maybe if you didn’t mess around so much, we’d already be gone.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.Maybe if you didn’t mess around so much, we’d already be gone.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.Maybe if you didn’t mess around so much, we’d already be gone."

translation: Gdybyś tyle nie kombinował, już by nas tu nie było.

source_text: Don’t even pretend this is my fault.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Don’t even pretend this is my fault.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Don’t even pretend this is my fault."

translation: Nawet nie udawaj, że to moja wina.

source_text: He’s distracted…

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp.He’s distracted…

source_text: 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: JoBaOp.1Hero?

source_text: Oh… Hey, Jon. I have some stuff to sell you.

structure.raw_value: McHaCl.Oh… Hey, Jon. I have some stuff to sell you.
structure.script_literal: "McHaCl.Oh… Hey, Jon. I have some stuff to sell you."

translation: O… Hej, Jon. Mam coś na sprzedaż.

source_text: Some more treasures?

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.Some more treasures?

source_text: Uhh… Yeah. I heard you inside of the warehouse.

structure.raw_value: McHaEx.Uhh… Yeah. I heard you inside of the warehouse.
structure.script_literal: "McHaEx.Uhh… Yeah. I heard you inside of the warehouse."

translation: Yyy… Tak. Słyszałem cię w środku magazynu.

source_text: Well… Show me what you got.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.Well… Show me what you got.

source_text: Hey, Jon. I’d like to inquire about a special project.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Hey, Jon. I’d like to inquire about a special project.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Hey, Jon. I’d like to inquire about a special project."

translation: Hej, Jon. Chciałbym zapytać o specjalny projekt.

source_text: A special project? What're you thinking?

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.A special project? What're you thinking?

translation: Specjalny projekt? Co masz na myśli?

source_text: I’ve got some things I need to store…

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I’ve got some things I need to store…
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I’ve got some things I need to store…"

source_text: Things I don’t want the cops finding out about.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Things I don’t want the cops finding out about.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Things I don’t want the cops finding out about."

translation: Takich, o których nie chcę, by gliny się dowiedziały.

source_text: Say no more, 1Hero. I never want to know the details of a client's needs.

structure.raw_value: JoFrDe.Say no more, 1Hero. I never want to know the details of a client's needs.
structure.script_literal: "JoFrDe.Say no more, 1Hero. I never want to know the details of a client's needs."

translation: Nie musisz mówić więcej, 1Hero. Nigdy nie chcę znać szczegółów potrzeb klienta.

source_text: So, you can help?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.So, you can help?

source_text: Where would you store them? They can’t go here.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Where would you store them? They can’t go here.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Where would you store them? They can’t go here."

translation: Gdzie byś je przechował? Nie mogą tu zostać.

source_text: My warehouse isn’t good enough for you?

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.My warehouse isn’t good enough for you?
structure.script_literal: "JoBaDe.My warehouse isn’t good enough for you?"

source_text: It’s got to be secure.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.It’s got to be secure.

source_text: I’ve got you covered if it’s small. I have safes that can’t be broken into.

structure.raw_value: JoFlEx.I’ve got you covered if it’s small. I have safes that can’t be broken into.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlEx.I’ve got you covered if it’s small. I have safes that can’t be broken into."

translation: Jeśli małe, mam sejfy, do których nie da się włamać.

source_text: No… Not small… Something really big.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.No… Not small… Something really big.

translation: Nie… Nie małe… Coś naprawdę dużego.

source_text: How big?

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.How big?

source_text: Uhhh… The size of a car.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Uhhh… The size of a car.

source_text: I’d ask what it is, but I don’t want to know…

structure.raw_value: JoFlDe.I’d ask what it is, but I don’t want to know…
structure.script_literal: "JoFlDe.I’d ask what it is, but I don’t want to know…"

translation: Spytałbym, co to, ale wolę nie wiedzieć…

source_text: You bring it here, and I can help you out. But it’ll cost ya.

structure.raw_value: JoFlEx.You bring it here, and I can help you out. But it’ll cost ya.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlEx.You bring it here, and I can help you out. But it’ll cost ya."

translation: Przywieź to tutaj, a ci pomogę. Ale będzie kosztować.

source_text: Okay, Jon. I’ll think about it.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Okay, Jon. I’ll think about it.

source_text: What do you need, detective?

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.What do you need, detective?

source_text: I need a spare apartment key.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I need a spare apartment key.

source_text: That Abraham girl lost another key?

structure.raw_value: JoAnDe.That Abraham girl lost another key?

translation: Ta dziewczyna Abraham znowu zgubiła klucz?

source_text: No… I’m investigating someone else.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.No… I’m investigating someone else.

source_text: Ah. Doing a warrantless search?

structure.raw_value: JoFlDe.Ah. Doing a warrantless search?

source_text: I’ll scratch your back, 1Hero. But you need to give me something first.

structure.raw_value: JoFlEx.I’ll scratch your back, 1Hero. But you need to give me something first.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlEx.I’ll scratch your back, 1Hero. But you need to give me something first."

translation: Podrapię ci plecy, 1Hero. Ale musisz mi coś dać najpierw.

source_text: I can find some treasures.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I can find some treasures.

source_text: I’ve got something else in mind.

structure.raw_value: JoFlDe.I’ve got something else in mind.

source_text: I’ve been doing some diving in Casula Forest… I’m looking for underwater caves.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.I’ve been doing some diving in Casula Forest… I’m looking for underwater caves.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.I’ve been doing some diving in Casula Forest… I’m looking for underwater caves."

translation: Nurkowałem w Lesie Casula… Szukam podwodnych jaskiń.

source_text: You want me to find a cave?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.You want me to find a cave?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.You want me to find a cave?"

source_text: No… I want you to find something I lost while diving.

structure.raw_value: JoFrEx.No… I want you to find something I lost while diving.
structure.script_literal: "JoFrEx.No… I want you to find something I lost while diving."

translation: Nie… Chcę, byś znalazł coś, co zgubiłem podczas nurkowania.

source_text: Underwater? How would I do that?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Underwater? How would I do that?

translation: Pod wodą? Jak miałbym to zrobić?

source_text: You’ve got a knack for finding treasure. I think you can handle it.

structure.raw_value: JoFlEx.You’ve got a knack for finding treasure. I think you can handle it.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlEx.You’ve got a knack for finding treasure. I think you can handle it."

translation: Masz nosa do skarbów. Myślę, że dasz radę.

source_text: What am I looking for?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.What am I looking for?

source_text: A gold coin… Polished and shiny as of last month.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.A gold coin… Polished and shiny as of last month.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.A gold coin… Polished and shiny as of last month."

translation: Złotej monety… Wypolerowanej i błyszczącej miesiąc temu.

source_text: I’ve searched for it since I dropped it, but I just can't seem to find it.

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.I’ve searched for it since I dropped it, but I just can't seem to find it.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaDe.I’ve searched for it since I dropped it, but I just can't seem to find it."

translation: Szukałem jej, odkąd ją zgubiłem, ale nijak nie mogę znaleźć.

source_text: Where did you drop it?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Where did you drop it?

source_text: It was near the waterfall, in heavy current.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.It was near the waterfall, in heavy current.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.It was near the waterfall, in heavy current."

translation: Było przy wodospadzie, w silnym nurcie.

source_text: You can handle it. And when you find it, I’ll give you the key.

structure.raw_value: JoFlEx.You can handle it. And when you find it, I’ll give you the key.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlEx.You can handle it. And when you find it, I’ll give you the key."

translation: Dasz radę. A gdy ją znajdziesz, dam ci klucz.

source_text: Here, take my diving mask.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.Here, take my diving mask.

translation: Proszę, weź moją maskę do nurkowania.

source_text: You’ll need more than this to handle the rough currents. But it’s a start.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.You’ll need more than this to handle the rough currents. But it’s a start.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.You’ll need more than this to handle the rough currents. But it’s a start."

translation: Będziesz potrzebował więcej niż tego, by poradzić sobie z rwącym nurtem. Ale to początek.

source_text: You found my coin!

structure.raw_value: JoHaOp.You found my coin!

source_text: A deal’s a deal. What key do you need?

structure.raw_value: JoFlDe.A deal’s a deal. What key do you need?
structure.script_literal: "JoFlDe.A deal’s a deal. What key do you need?"

translation: Umowa to umowa. Jakiego klucza potrzebujesz?

source_text: The key to the easternmost apartment.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.The key to the easternmost apartment.

source_text: Hey! Don’t touch that spool of copper. It’s valuable.

structure.raw_value: JoAnOp.Hey! Don’t touch that spool of copper. It’s valuable.
structure.script_literal: "JoAnOp.Hey! Don’t touch that spool of copper. It’s valuable."

translation: Hej! Nie dotykaj tej szpuli miedzi. Jest cenna.

source_text: How much do you want for it?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.How much do you want for it?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.How much do you want for it?"

source_text: I’d part with it for $900.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.I’d part with it for $900.

source_text: Seems steep.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Seems steep.

source_text: Are you planning to go back to the mansion?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Are you planning to go back to the mansion?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Are you planning to go back to the mansion?"
